---
name: "💡 Feature Request"
about: "Suggest an idea for a new builder feature, template customization, or UI enhancement."
title: "[FEATURE] <Short title for the enhancement>"
labels: "enhancement"
assignees: ""

---

## 🎯 Objective
Is your feature request related to a specific problem or just a general improvement? Please describe the motivation behind this request (e.g., wanting a multiplayer lobby mode or category filters).

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of the feature or functionality you would like to see implemented in Packora.

## 📐 Design & UI
If this is a UI enhancement, how does it fit into the modern Jetpack Compose Glassmorphic style? Describe any visual changes or additions (e.g., custom icon generators or settings cards).

## ⚙️ APK Builder Engine & Pipeline
If this requires changes to the build pipeline or AXML formulas:
- Necessary manifest attributes or modifications
- Keystore/signing flow changes
- Generated APK impact

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered to solve the same problem.

---
*Your feedback drives Packora's evolution. Thank you for contributing!*
